column1: # tools/tape/facts/tapeslice-container.tsv -- T0.1 UTAPEBIN minor=3 slice container contract (M0/M1 tool-line)
# Bytes 24..27 = dir_off (64), bytes 28..59 = 32-byte sha256 ident, bytes 60..63 = origin (0..6).
# Directory starts at offset 64 with 6 fixed 24-byte rows (CODE, DATA, BSSZ, SYMS, RELO, HOST), ending at 208.
# RELO.pos contract: operand LEB128 byte offset in CODE (0 < pos < code_len, non-insn-start, [pos,pos+width) off ibitmap instruction-start bits).

column6: check
equal UTAPEBIN 8-byte container magic
equal 1 major version
equal 3 exact match (reject minor < 3 and future unknown minor > 3)
equal 1 little-endian
equal 0 reserved flags
entry byte offset inside CODE (0 <= entry_off < code_len, must hit decoded instruction start in T0.3 args[10] ibitmap)
equal 6 sections and directory 64..208 fits in file
equal 64 section directory offset
sha256 over full container with header bytes 28..59 zeroed must match
target origin 0..6 matching tapegate tb2_origin at +60
section 0 tag CODE (LEB-encoded tape instruction stream)
section 0 file offset (8-byte aligned, equal 208)
section 0 byte length in container
section 0 instruction count
section 1 tag DATA (.str and initialized data bytes)
section 1 file offset (8-byte aligned, zero-padded from CODE end)
section 1 byte length in container
section 1 data item count
section 2 tag BSSZ (8-byte u64 zero-initialized BSS byte length)
section 2 file offset (8-byte aligned, zero-padded from DATA end)
section 2 byte length (fixed 8 bytes storing u64 bss_size)
section 2 record count (fixed 1)
section 3 tag SYMS (16B rows: name_off u32 in DATA NUL-terminated, sect u8 0..3, kind u8 0..3, rsv u16=0, val u64)
section 3 file offset (8-byte aligned, zero-padded from BSSZ end)
section 3 byte length (multiple of 16)
section 3 symbol row count (len / 16)

section 4 tag RELO (16B rows: pos u64 operand LEB byte offset in CODE with 0<pos<code_len and [pos,pos+width) off insn-start ibitmap bits, kind u8 0=code/1=data/2=bss/3=host, width u8 1..10, rsv u16=0, addend i32 signed)
section 4 file offset (8-byte aligned, zero-padded from SYMS end)
section 4 byte length (multiple of 16)
section 4 relocation row count (len / 16)
section 5 tag HOST (cnt records of slot u16 0..36 + name_len u16 + ASCII name matching canonical 37 hoststub slots, exact sum==len)
section 5 file offset (8-byte aligned, zero-padded from RELO end)
section 5 byte length (sect_host_off + sect_host_len must equal container file size)
section 5 required host call count
